resources.string: Tasker and adb, action links, the token
Tasker, MacroDroid, adb and links that carry the token can start, stop and switch BirdSocks. Off: every request is refused.
Every broadcast carries it in the secret extra, and a link with &secret= runs without asking. Whoever has it controls BirdSocks.
No token of at least %1$d characters: every request is refused. Generate one.
Android did not let automation start BirdSocks in the background. Exempt it from battery optimization in Settings → Background & permissions.
